crossRefs.note: Of Benjamin: Abidan the son of Gideoni.
On the ninth day Abidan the son of Gideoni, prince of the children of Benjamin,

people.name: Abidan
people.line: Leader of the tribe of Benjamin during the Exodus

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Gideoni
people.line: Leader of the tribe of Benjamin during the Exodus.

translations.web: Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin.
translations.bsb: and Abidan son of Gideoni was over the division of the tribe of Benjamin.
translations.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.
translations.asv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.
